q: 3. The contractor shall submit an application to the employer for extension of time, stating the causes for delay, ……… days before the expiry of contract completion date.
explain: The number of days is missing from the printed stem. Per the key, 21 days.

q: 4. The employer shall pay the interim bill within ……… days after the bill submitted by the contractor.
5. Time extension may need to be granted due to
explain: Time extensions can be warranted by force majeure events as well as delays caused by the purchaser/employer - both a and b.

q: 6. Maximum amount that can be paid to the contractor as a prize for the early finishing of the works is equal to ……… % of the contract amount.
7. Percentage of retention money is equal to ……… % of each payment made to the contractor.
8. Which of the following is not a bid document?
explain: The letter of acceptance is issued after bid evaluation and is not part of the bid documents.

q: 9. The purpose of bid evaluation is to evaluate
explain: Evaluation identifies the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder.

q: 10. As per public the public procurement regulation 2064, who approves the prequalification criteria?
explain: Per the answer key, the concerned department chief.

q: 11. While filling the tender for any work, the contractor considers
explain: A contractor considers site conditions, material availability, and labour availability while preparing a tender bid - all of the above.

q: 12. In a sealed quotation, the successful bidder should deliver the performance security within ……… days of receipt of letter of acceptance.
13. The remuneration of dispute adjudication board is paid by
explain: The client and contractor share the cost.

q: 14. A surety bond issued by an insurance company or a bank that provides legal guarantee to the owner or employer that the bidder will sign the contract if it is awarded to him is called
explain: Bid security is the surety bond guaranteeing that the successful bidder will sign the contract if awarded.

q: 15. The money deposited by the contractor as the guarantee of tender is known as
explain: Bid bond and earnest money are both tender guarantees.

q: 16. When actual cost of construction plus certain profit is paid to the contractor then such a contract is known as
explain: A cost-plus-percentage contract pays the contractor actual costs incurred plus an agreed percentage as profit.

q: 17. Which of the following is done first in procurement of consulting services
explain: The Expression of Interest (EOI) comes first, then short listing, then RFP.

q: 18. A contractor can start the construction works with following the receipt of
explain: The 'notice to proceed' is the formal authorization document that allows the contractor to commence construction works.
